**Judgments cited (fiscal 2021 10-K, deferral as of January 30, 2021):** Because of the quantity and diverse nature of its vendor agreements, management must estimate how much funding to recognize in earnings and how much to defer as an offset to inventory. This requires analyzing (1) the proper classification of the type of funding received and (2) the methodology for estimating the portion of purchases-based funding to recognize in cost of sales each period. That methodology considers inventory turn by product category and actual sell-through of inventory [6].

**Stability:** The filing says the overall level of deferral has remained relatively stable over the last three years. A 10% change in the deferral would have affected net earnings by about $33 million in fiscal 2021 [6].
